title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 current SGA working record: SGA 6 complete and SGA 7-I complete through source page 528
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record keeps the current reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and compact source ZIPs for SGA translation/reconstruction work.

Status at a glance. SGA 5 high-fidelity source-checked stream is complete through printed page 484. SGA 6 strict source-checked French/English stream is complete through the original source scan, including terminological and notation indexes at source pages 693-702. SGA 7-I source-checked English/French working edition is complete through source page 528. The existing SGA 3 English translation has been rebuilt to remove raw code-block typography, but is not yet a full mathematical re-typeset.

Latest update. Adds source-checked English/French SGA 7-I cumulative readers through source page 528, the matching complete source-scan witness for SGA 7-I, and the SGA 7-I p505-528 source packet. This pass covers the Expose IX conclusion, Section 13.5, Section 14, and bibliography, completing the SGA 7-I scan in this intake. The next anchor is SGA 7-II source scan intake.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Latest update adds source-checked English/French SGA 7-I cumulative readers through source page 528 and the matching source packet/source scan witness, completing SGA 7-I in this intake. Next anchor: SGA 7-II source scan intake.
